The skies inside Frontier I.
Side 3, the colony farthest from Earth,
rows.desc_en: named itself the Principality of Zeon and waged a war of independence on the Earth Fed. Govt. Named for lasting about a year, it saw new tactics such as MS and colony drops upend old ideas of war, and the Earth Sphere lost about half its population.

rows.model_en: A Federation Forces plan to develop mobile
rows.desc_en: suits to counter Zeon. Its aim was to build prototypes - the support-type Guntank and Guncannon and the general-purpose Gundam - and run operational tests toward mass production. In practice, it was completed once GM mass production got on track.

rows.model_en: The Fed. Forces' first major counterattack
rows.desc_en: of the One Year War. Seizing on Garma Zabi's death in N. America, they planned to retake Odessa in Europe, Zeon's most vital base left on Earth. Aided by White Base, the Fed. won, and Zeon's ground forces fell into dire straits.

rows.model_en: Zeon's plan to strike Jaburo, the Fed.
rows.desc_en: Forces HQ, directly. By tailing White Base, Char Aznable located Jaburo's entrance. Zeon aimed for a two-front attack: saboteurs inside, bombing and airdrop units outside. But flawed sabotage and a lack of forces made the operation fail.

rows.model_en: Fed. commander Gen. Revil led the fleet
rows.desc_en: himself to break through A Baoa Qu, the fortress on Zeon's last defense line, and invade Side 3 itself. But Zeon's secret weapon, the Solar Ray, killed Revil. Chaos followed, but Zabi infighting made Zeon self-destruct, ending the One Year War.

rows.model_en: A plan to build a flying mobile armor with
rows.desc_en: a powerful mega particle cannon to attack Fed. bases. Led by Ginius Sakhalin, research and tests took place in Asia. After trials of the test units Apsaras I and II, Apsaras III wiped out a Fed. base in combat, but was destroyed by the Ez8.

rows.model_en: A Zeon plan to steal a Gundam after
rows.desc_en: learning of a new Fed. Gundam project. Special forces Cyclops Team tried twice, in Antarctica and at Side 6, and failed. Desperate, Cmdr. Killing plotted a nuclear strike to destroy the Gundam, colony and all, but the Fed. stopped it just in time.

rows.model_en: A conflict started in U.C. 0083 by the
rows.desc_en: Delaz Fleet, a Zeon remnant force. It aimed to drop a colony on Earth to hit its food supply, making Earth more dependent on space for food and turning Federation eyes to space. The operation succeeded, but led to the rise of the Titans.

rows.label_en: H09 Theft of the Gundam GP02
rows.model_en: Phase one of the Delaz Fleet's Operation
rows.desc_en: Stardust. Major Anavel Gato stole the Gundam GP02 as it was moved to Australia, joined the Zeon remnant forces in Africa, and carried it off into space. The GP02 was armed with a nuclear warhead, later used to attack the Naval Review.

rows.label_en: H10 Assault on the Naval Review
rows.model_en: Phase two of the Delaz Fleet's Operation
rows.desc_en: Stardust: an attack on the Naval Review at Konpei Island (formerly Solomon) with the stolen GP02's nuclear warhead, to cut Fed. strength in space and pave the way for the colony drop, the main Stardust operation. The Fed. fleet took a heavy blow.

rows.model_en: Exploiting the turmoil of the Delaz
rows.desc_en: Conflict, radical Fed. official Jamitov Hymen managed to found the Titans, an elite force created in the name of "hunting Zeon remnants." The Titans' leaders, centered on Bask Om, were prejudiced against Spacenoids and oppressed them.

rows.model_en: The AEUG formed to resist the Titans'
rows.desc_en: oppression of Spacenoids. Axis, a Zeon remnant force, then joined the fight, making it three-way. The period from the Gundam Mk-II theft to the Titans' defeat is called the Gryps Conflict. Gryps is a colony converted into a laser cannon.

rows.model_en: In U.C. 0085, when residents of the 30
rows.desc_en: Bunch colony in Side 1 staged an anti-Federation demonstration, the Titans gassed the colony, massacring 15 million residents. A media blackout kept it secret, but anti-Titans voices grew in the Fed. Forces, sparking the AEUG's founding.

rows.model_en: An AEUG attack on the Fed. HQ. The plan was
rows.desc_en: to drop MS from outside the atmosphere and seize Jaburo directly, but the Titans had set a trap to wipe out the AEUG forces with a nuclear bomb. The AEUG units sensed it and escaped, so neither side gained much from the operation.

rows.name_en: Axis Returns to the Earth Sphere
rows.label_en: H15 Axis Returns to the Earth Sphere
rows.model_en: Exploiting the AEUG-Titans strife, Axis,
rows.desc_en: the largest Zeon remnant force, led by Haman Karn, returned to the Earth Sphere. After 7 years building up in the Asteroid Belt, Axis held its forces back in the Gryps Conflict, using shrewd maneuvering to drive the Titans to collapse.

rows.model_en: The Titans kept pursuing the Audhumla
rows.desc_en: (AEUG-Karaba alliance) after it went from N. America to Hong Kong to resupply. Their reinforcements: the Psycho Gundam and its pilot, Cyber Newtype Four Murasame. The Psycho Gundam fought a street battle in Hong Kong City, causing heavy damage.

rows.model_en: The Titans moved to seize the lunar city of
rows.desc_en: Von Braun, to gain a base for attacking Granada, the AEUG's lunar HQ, and to flaunt their power to the Fed. Assembly so a bill expanding their authority would pass. The takeover succeeded at first, but the AEUG's efforts won the city back.
rows.note: Translated as written (JP calls Granada the AEUG's lunar base).

rows.label_en: H18 Assassination of Brigadier General Blex
rows.model_en: A bill to maximize the Titans' power went
rows.desc_en: before the Fed. Assembly. The AEUG's Brig. Gen. Blex attended the assembly to block it, planning to expose the Titans' atrocities. But the Titans assassinated Blex at the hotel where he was staying, and as a result the bill was passed.

rows.model_en: An attack on Kilimanjaro base, the Titans'
rows.desc_en: largest stronghold on Earth. Led by Karaba, with the Argama joining in, a lightning strike captured the base. Titans Supreme Commander Jamitov was at Kilimanjaro at the time, but escaped into space under the Psycho Gundam's escort.

rows.label_en: H20 Seizure of the Dakar Assembly
rows.model_en: Gaining the upper hand in the fighting on
rows.desc_en: Earth, the AEUG and Karaba moved to seize the assembly in Dakar. There, the AEUG's Quattro Bajeena revealed he was Char Aznable and denounced the Titans' tyranny to the world. The speech swung public opinion strongly toward the AEUG.

rows.model_en: Amid the chaos after Jamitov's
rows.desc_en: assassination, Axis took the Gryps 2 colony laser from the Titans, and the AEUG planned to retake it. Maelstrom refers to five fleets advancing as if drawing a whirlpool. The operation succeeded and also stopped the Axis drop on Granada.

rows.model_en: The Gryps Conflict ended with the Titans'
rows.desc_en: destruction, but Haman's Axis still had ample forces left. Declaring the revival of Zeon, it renamed itself "Neo Zeon." The weakened Earth Federation and AEUG could not stop Neo Zeon's invasion, and war broke out once again, lasting about a year.

rows.model_en: Haman's Neo Zeon forces sent descent units
rows.desc_en: to conquer Earth. Their very first target was Dakar, seat of the Fed. Assembly. Fearing Haman's power, Federation lawmakers recognized the restoration of the Zabi family for the sake of peace, and handed Side 3 over to Neo Zeon.

rows.model_en: Blocked at Dakar from winning recognition
rows.desc_en: of Neo Zeon as a nation, Haman launched her next plan: a colony drop on Dublin to show off Neo Zeon's power. Some top Fed. officials suppressed the information, hoping to use it to cut Earth's population. It caused a massive death toll.

rows.model_en: Glemy Toto, a commander leading troops,
rows.desc_en: suddenly seized Axis, declared to Haman that he was Zeon's rightful heir, and rebelled. This split Neo Zeon in two. Caught between Haman and the AEUG (Nahel Argama), Glemy's forces were worn down, and he himself fell in battle.

rows.model_en: Four years after Haman fell in the First
rows.desc_en: Neo Zeon War, the missing Char Aznable reappeared in the Earth Sphere, seized Sweetwater, and declared Neo Zeon's revival. Vowing to free the souls of people bound by Earth's gravity, Char declared war on the Earth Federation Government.

rows.model_en: Having declared war on the Federation, Char
rows.desc_en: moved at once to drop the resource asteroid Fifth Luna on the Fed. Forces HQ in Tibet to weaken them. The Fed. Forces tried to stop it, but their only real force was the new Londo Bell, and Fifth Luna hit Earth before they were ready.

rows.model_en: After the Fifth Luna drop, Char obtained
rows.desc_en: the asteroid Axis in a secret deal with the Fed. government. Deceiving the Fed., Char tried to drop Axis on Earth. Londo Bell failed to stop it and Axis entered its fall trajectory, but the miraculous power of the Psycho-Frame pushed it off course.

rows.model_en: In U.C. 0123, the founding of Cosmo
rows.desc_en: Babylonia was declared in the Frontier Side, a new colony cluster. Its leader Meitzer upheld "aristocratism," swiftly took military control of the Frontier Side with the private army Crossbone Vanguard, and declared war on the Earth Federation.

rows.model_en: Carozzo Ronah, alias Iron Mask, Supreme
rows.desc_en: Commander of the Crossbone Vanguard, secretly planned to cut the unneeded population to make humanity endure, building the unmanned killing weapon "Bug" and giant MA "Rafflesia." But Seabook and his allies foiled the plan.

decisions: M cards: titles reuse the stage titles already in out/briefing_0*.json; model_jp is a blank full-width space, so model_en and desc_en are empty.

S and H cards: model_jp holds the first line of the description and desc_jp the rest (the JP even splits words across the two). The English was written as one paragraph and split at a word boundary: model_en = first <=43 bytes, desc_en = the rest, checked to wrap (43 B/line) within desc_lines_max. The orchestrator may re-split.
S cards with a different label_jp (S16-S19) translate the shorter label text.
H card names use the glossary event names, capitalised as titles.
JP quote brackets around Operation Stardust in H-09/H-10 dropped (the name is self-evident); other quoted terms kept in double quotes.
uncertain: H-06: Apsaras I not in glossary (II/III are); wrote 'Apsaras I'. JP 'Ez8' kept as 'the Ez8'.
M-50/M-51: 'Hong Kong City' card titles have no matching briefing title (the Hong Kong story stage is 'Cinderella Four'); kept literal.
